settings.tagline: Stronger, shinier hair — from the root.

settings.title: Nourishes from the root
settings.text: Massaged into the scalp, it feeds the roots so hair feels stronger wash after wash.

settings.title: 100% natural ingredients
settings.text: Neelayamari and coconut — the way Kerala has cared for hair for generations.

settings.title: Stronger, shinier hair
settings.text: Softens the lengths and brings back natural shine.

settings.title: For all hair types
settings.text: Straight, wavy or curly — gentle enough for regular use.

settings.title: Apply
settings.text: Part your hair and apply the oil directly to the scalp with the comb applicator.

settings.title: Massage
settings.text: Massage gently with your fingertips for 3–5 minutes to work it through the roots.

settings.title: Leave & wash
settings.text: Leave on for at least an hour, or overnight, then wash with the Anti-Dandruff Shampoo.
